## What does this change?

Describe the user-visible issue or contribution opportunity and link relevant issue(s).

## How was it tested?

- [ ] Rust compilation/tests (`cargo check --all-targets && cargo test`)
- [ ] Next.js typecheck/build
- [ ] Docker Compose configuration and/or local demo
- [ ] Relevant provider behavior or permission edge cases (if connector change)
- [ ] Tests/docs added or explicitly explained why they were not needed

## Data, security and compatibility

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private records or scraped real-user content committed
- [ ] Third-party content rights, source attribution, rate limits and deletion implications reviewed where relevant
- [ ] Backward compatibility and local-only deployment assumptions considered
- [ ] Docs, changelog or known limitations updated if behavior changed

## Screenshots or examples (optional)

Use synthetic content or redacted screenshots only.
